pages.title: Architecture
pages.summary: High-level system architecture and core components.

sections.title: Architecture
sections.body_markdown: This page describes the overall architecture of the Predictive Maintenance Management System, including key containers and their responsibilities.

sections.title: Core components
sections.body_markdown:
- **Frontend (Angular):** Docs-style UI (sidebar nav, main content, TOC)
- **Backend (FastAPI):** REST endpoints for docs navigation/content
- **Database:** (future) durable storage for equipment telemetry, alerts, and work orders

sections.title: Deployment
sections.body_markdown: The system is split into independently deployable services. Environment variables configure base URLs and runtime behavior.

pages.title: User Stories
pages.summary: User stories describing UI flows and API expectations.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body_markdown: This page lists user stories and supporting API surface for documentation-style navigation and content.

sections.title: Models
sections.body_markdown:
- `DocPage`: id, slug, title, summary
- `DocSection`: id, title, level, body_markdown
- `TocItem`: id, title, level (derived from sections)

sections.title: Schemas
sections.body_markdown: All endpoints return JSON and are documented in OpenAPI.
